title: "Error: original.line and original.column are not numbers" after upgrading to 7.11.5

labels.name: outdated
labels.description: A closed issue/PR that is archived due to age. Recommended to make a new issue

body:
## Bug Report


<!--
@babel/eslint-parser:
  If you are having issues with JSX you might want to check out eslint-plugin-react. If there's an issue with new experimental syntax you might need check if it's supported by @babel/eslint-plugin.
-->

**Current behavior**

Transpiling basic file with `--source-maps` option crashes as follows

```
$ babel index.js -o dist/index.js --source-maps
Error: original.line and original.column are not numbers -- you probably meant to omit the original mapping entirely and only map the generated position. If so, pass null for the original mapping instead of an object with empty or null values.
    at SourceMapGenerator_validateMapping [as _validateMapping] (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/node_modules/source-map/lib/source-map-generator.js:276:15)
    at SourceMapGenerator_addMapping [as addMapping] (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/node_modules/source-map/lib/source-map-generator.js:110:12)
    at /Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/lib/babel/file.js:116:17
    at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
    at BasicSourceMapConsumer.SourceMapConsumer_eachMapping [as eachMapping] (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/node_modules/source-map/lib/source-map-consumer.js:157:14)
    at buildResult (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/lib/babel/file.js:114:20)
    at output (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/lib/babel/file.js:150:22)
    at /Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/lib/babel/file.js:248:9
    at Generator.next (<anonymous>)
    at asyncGeneratorStep (/Users/medikoo/npm-packages/@serverless/enterprise-plugin/node_modules/@babel/cli/lib/babel/file.js:86:103)
```


**Input Code**

```js
'use strict';

// some comment
```

**Expected behavior**

Should transpile without error (as it was in v7.11.4)

**Babel Configuration (babel.config.js, .babelrc, package.json#babel, cli command, .eslintrc)**
- Filename: `.babelrc`

```js
{
  "presets": [
    ["@babel/env", {
      "targets": {
        "node": "6"
      }
    }]
  ]
}
```
